name: Runway
tagline: AI video and image creation with text prompts, reference frames, and generation controls.
description: Runway is an AI creative platform for generating video and images. Supported video models can create a shot from text or animate an image, with prompts describing subjects, motion, and camera behavior. You can adjust supported settings, iterate on the result, and download it for use in a wider production workflow. Models and export options vary by plan.

features.label: Text-to-video generation
features.text: Describe a scene and its motion to generate a video shot with a supported model.

features.label: Image-to-video generation
features.text: Upload an image as a starting frame and use a prompt to guide how the scene moves.

features.label: Shot controls and export
features.text: Choose supported duration and framing settings, refine prompts, and download or upscale selected outputs.

useCases.label: Prototype a shot
useCases.text: Explore a scene, camera direction, or movement before deciding which concept to develop further.

useCases.label: Animate a visual concept
useCases.text: Use a still image to establish the composition, then generate motion for a short video sequence.

limitations: Input formats, clip length, resolution, and platform availability differ by model; check the selected model's guide.
Generations consume credits at rates that depend on the model and output settings.
The Free plan has a limited selection of tools and one-time credits; some models and export options require paid access.
guide.pricingNote: A Free plan provides one-time credits for selected tools. Paid plans add monthly credits and features; check current rates and the credit cost of your chosen model.

faqs.question: Can Runway turn a still image into a video?
faqs.answer: Yes. Supported image-to-video models accept an image and a motion prompt. Available durations, aspect ratios, and other controls depend on the model.

faqs.question: How does Runway charge for generations?
faqs.answer: Runway uses credits for image, video, and audio generation. Costs depend on the tool and settings, so check the current credit table before starting a series of generations.
